notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1): resolve $poolManager to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and $token to the newly deployed SIMDTEST. Deploy SIMDTESTHook directly with CREATE2 permission bits 0x20cc, then initialize and seed atomically through the launch factory. SIMDTEST mints all 1e27 units to its deployer; the factory handles the 10% swarm Merkle allocation, 90% pool seed and remainderTo. No token or hook allocation logic. Pool initialPrice is provenance only; the factory determines opening price from launch economics. Hook fees are separate from the static 1.25% LP fee: anti-snipe is 30% at opening block B, falls 3 percentage points per block, and is zero at B+10; growth is always 0.5%. Only IMD is charged. Specified-side fees use the filled share of the requested IMD amount; unspecified-side fees use actual core IMD deltas. Partial fills are supported through a rollback-only quote, without retaining any simulated swap. Fees accrue as IMD ERC-6909 claims owned by the hook, so swaps need no immediate IMD withdrawal. Anyone may sweep anti-snipe claims to 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985. Anyone may donateBatch after 3600 seconds from initialization or the last successful batch, donating floor(pending()/2), bounded by the manager's int128 delta limit. Donation burns claims to settle PoolManager.donate and rewards currently in-range LPs; it creates no LP position. No fees are converted, no underlying tokens burned, no owner, admin, setters, proxy or upgradeability. pending() and lastBatch() expose the growth reserve and timer. Empty or failed donations preserve both. See README.md and docs/SECURITY-REVIEW.md for accounting, rounding, deployment requirements and fork validation status.
